ESI relates to CT abnormality but whether it does so beyond the spirometry
already in the framework, and stratified by airflow limitation, because a
pooled figure over a cohort this heterogeneous mostly reflects severity.

```{r esi-visual-ct}
auc <- function(score, lab) {
  lab <- as.logical(lab)
  n1 <- sum(lab); n0 <- sum(!lab)
  if (n1 == 0 || n0 == 0) return(NA_real_)
  r <- rank(score)
  (sum(r[lab]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * n0)
}
d_b$emph_pos <- d_b$emph_yn
d_b$wall_pos <- d_b$wall_yn

# Mean ESI at each level of each visual scale.
lvl_rows <- list()
EMPH_LAB <- c("none","trace","mild","moderate","confluent","advanced destructive")
for (k in 0:5) {
  i <- which(d_b$CT_Visual_Emph_Severity == k)
  if (length(i)) lvl_rows[[length(lvl_rows)+1]] <- data.frame(
    criterion = "Visual emphysema", level = k, label = EMPH_LAB[k+1],
    n = length(i), mean_ESI = mean(d_b$ESI[i]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
WALL_LAB <- c("absent","borderline","definite")
for (k in 0:2) {
  i <- which(d_b$CT_Visual_Wall_Thickening == k)
  if (length(i)) lvl_rows[[length(lvl_rows)+1]] <- data.frame(
    criterion = "Airway wall thickening", level = k, label = WALL_LAB[k+1],
    n = length(i), mean_ESI = mean(d_b$ESI[i]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
esi_ct_levels <- do.call(rbind, lvl_rows)
# ESI must rise monotonically across both scales for the dose-response
# statement in the Results to hold.
for (cr in unique(esi_ct_levels$criterion)) {
  v <- esi_ct_levels$mean_ESI[esi_ct_levels$criterion == cr]
  stopifnot(all(diff(v) > 0))
}
write.csv(esi_ct_levels, file.path(OUT_DIR, "esi_ct_levels.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Discrimination of each criterion, pooled and by airflow limitation.
strata <- list(list("All participants", rep(TRUE, nrow(d_b))),
               list("Airflow limitation", d_b$afl),
               list("Preserved spirometry", !d_b$afl))
crit <- list(list("Visual emphysema", d_b$emph_pos),
             list("Airway wall thickening", d_b$wall_pos))
auc_rows <- list()
for (st in strata) for (cr in crit) {
  i <- which(st[[2]]); y <- cr[[2]][i]
  auc_rows[[length(auc_rows)+1]] <- data.frame(
    stratum = st[[1]], criterion = cr[[1]], n = length(i),
    prevalence = 100 * mean(y),
    auc_ESI = auc(d_b$ESI[i], y),
    auc_FEV1FVC = auc(-d_b$FEV1_FVC_post[i], y), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
esi_ct_auc <- do.call(rbind, auc_rows)
write.csv(esi_ct_auc, file.path(OUT_DIR, "esi_ct_auc.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
kable(esi_ct_levels, digits = 2, caption = "Mean ESI at each level of the two visual CT criteria.")
kable(esi_ct_auc, digits = 3, caption = "Discrimination of each visual CT criterion, by ESI and by FEV1/FVC.")
```

## Section 8c.2 -- Baseline ESI and subsequent decline in GOLD 0

```{r continuous-esi-gold0}
g0 <- fev1_long %>%
  inner_join(d_b %>% transmute(pid,
               ESI_baseline      = ESI_v1post,
               FEV1_FVC_baseline = FEV1_FVC_post,
               stratum_baseline  = stratum,
               Height_CM         = as.numeric(Height_CM),
               gender_baseline   = factor(gender),
               race_baseline     = factor(race)), by = "pid") %>%
  filter(stratum_baseline == "GOLD0", !is.na(Height_CM), !is.na(age_visit),
         !is.na(SmokCigNow), !is.na(ESI_baseline), !is.na(FEV1_FVC_baseline))

lmm_g0 <- lmer(FEV1_post_mL ~ years_from_baseline * (ESI_baseline + FEV1_FVC_baseline) +
                 Height_CM + age_visit + ATS_PackYears + SmokCigNow +
                 gender_baseline + race_baseline + (1 | pid), data = g0)
esi_int <- lmm_row(lmm_g0, "years_from_baseline:ESI_baseline")
g0_out <- data.frame(
  subgroup = "GOLD 0", est_mL_yr = unname(esi_int["est"]), se = unname(esi_int["se"]),
  p = unname(esi_int["p"]), n_subj = length(unique(g0$pid)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.csv(g0_out, file.path(OUT_DIR, "continuous_esi_gold0_decline.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("GOLD 0: each 1-unit higher baseline ESI predicts %.2f mL/yr of additional FEV1 decline (SE %.2f, p = %.3g), n = %d\n",
            esi_int["est"], esi_int["se"], esi_int["p"], nrow(g0_out) && length(unique(g0$pid))))
```

## Section 8c.3 -- ESI trajectory, PRISm against GOLD 0

```{r esi-trajectory}
esi_long <- esi_raw %>%
  filter(visitnum %in% c(1, 2, 3), PrePost == 1) %>%
  group_by(pid, visitnum) %>%
  summarise(ESI = mean(ESI, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
esi_v1 <- esi_long %>% filter(visitnum == 1) %>% dplyr::select(pid, ESI_v1 = ESI)
traj <- esi_long %>%
  filter(visitnum > 1) %>%
  inner_join(esi_v1, by = "pid") %>%
  mutate(dESI = ESI - ESI_v1) %>%
  inner_join(d_b %>% dplyr::select(pid, stratum), by = "pid") %>%
  filter(stratum %in% c("GOLD0", "PRISm")) %>%
  group_by(stratum, visitnum) %>%
  summarise(n = dplyr::n(), mean_dESI = mean(dESI, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_dESI = sd(dESI, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  as.data.frame()
write.csv(traj, file.path(OUT_DIR, "esi_trajectory.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
kable(traj, digits = 3, caption = "Change in ESI from baseline, by baseline stratum.")
```

## Section 8c.4 -- Bronchodilator response

Computed on this cohort. The earlier analysis reported this on all paired
measurements in COPDGene, which is a larger and differently constituted group
than the one this paper analyzes.

```{r bronchodilator-delta}
esi_pair <- esi_raw %>%
  filter(visitnum == 1, PrePost %in% c(0, 1)) %>%
  group_by(pid, PrePost) %>%
  summarise(ESI = mean(ESI, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = PrePost, values_from = ESI, names_prefix = "ESI_") %>%
  filter(!is.na(ESI_0), !is.na(ESI_1)) %>%

bd <- data.frame(n_paired = nrow(esi_pair),
                 mean_delta = mean(esi_pair$ESI_1 - esi_pair$ESI_0),

            bd$mean_delta, bd$sd_delta, bd$n_paired))
```

# Section 9 -- Concordant and discordant classification (MD-COPD vs ESI-MD-COPD)

Pairwise, as in the earlier analysis. NoCT-MD-COPD is not carried into this
comparison: it underdiagnoses a group with raised mortality, which the
preceding sections establish, so the question of what happens to individually
discordant participants is asked of ESI-MD-COPD alone.

Binary COPD status under each classification is cross-classified into four
groups. Restricted to preserved spirometry, where the two classifications can
actually disagree about a diagnosis rather than about which COPD category
applies.

```{r discordance-groups}
copd_of <- function(v) v %in% c("COPD-minor", "COPD-major")
mk_discord <- function(dd) factor(
  ifelse( copd_of(dd$S2) &  copd_of(dd$S4), "Both-COPD",
  ifelse( copd_of(dd$S2) & !copd_of(dd$S4), "CT-only-COPD",
  ifelse(!copd_of(dd$S2) &  copd_of(dd$S4), "ESI-only-COPD", "Both-noCOPD"))),
  levels = c("Both-noCOPD", "ESI-only-COPD", "CT-only-COPD", "Both-COPD"))

d_b$discord  <- mk_discord(d_b)
mort$discord <- mk_discord(mort)
exa$discord  <- mk_discord(exa)

# Preserved spirometry only.
d_ps    <- d_b[!d_b$afl, ]
mort_ps <- mort[!mort$afl, ]
exa_ps  <- exa[!exa$afl, ]
cat(sprintf("preserved-spirometry cohort: %d (mortality %d, exacerbation %d)\n\n",
            nrow(d_ps), nrow(mort_ps), nrow(exa_ps)))
print(table(d_ps$discord))

# CT-only-COPD is what ESI misses; ESI-only-COPD is what it adds.
disc_n <- as.data.frame(table(d_ps$discord), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(disc_n) <- c("group", "n")
write.csv(disc_n, file.path(OUT_DIR, "discord_counts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Structural and spirometric profile of the four groups, restored from the v15
# draft. The point is that the two discordant groups are picked out by
# different measurements, so their CT and ESI profiles should differ in
# opposite directions.
.pct <- function(v) 100 * mean(v, na.rm = TRUE)
.msd <- function(v) c(m = mean(v, na.rm = TRUE), s = sd(v, na.rm = TRUE),
                      n = sum(!is.na(v)))
disc_rows_p <- list()
for (g in levels(d_ps$discord)) {
  z <- d_ps[d_ps$discord == g, ]
  e <- .msd(z$ESI); l <- .msd(z$Insp_LAA950_total_Thirona)
  q <- .msd(z$PRM_pct_emphysema_Thirona)
  disc_rows_p[[length(disc_rows_p) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    group = g, n = nrow(z),
    pct_visual_emph = .pct(z$emph_yn),
    pct_wall_thick  = .pct(z$wall_yn),
    mean_ESI = unname(e["m"]), sd_ESI = unname(e["s"]),
    mean_LAA950 = unname(l["m"]), sd_LAA950 = unname(l["s"]),
    n_LAA950 = unname(l["n"]),
    mean_PRM = unname(q["m"]), sd_PRM = unname(q["s"]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
disc_profile <- do.call(rbind, disc_rows_p)
stopifnot(nrow(disc_profile) == 4, all(disc_profile$n > 0))
write.csv(disc_profile, file.path(OUT_DIR, "discord_profile.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# The same cross-classification within the airflow-limitation stratum, where
# MD-COPD and ESI-MD-COPD assign COPD-major or AFL-only and therefore disagree
# about whether a diagnosis is given rather than about which group applies.
# The reference is the participants both call AFL-only.
d_al <- d_b[d_b$afl, ]; mort_al <- mort[mort$afl, ]; exa_al <- exa[exa$afl, ]
mk_al <- function(dd) factor(
  ifelse(dd$S2 == "COPD-major" & dd$S4 == "COPD-major", "Both-COPD",
  ifelse(dd$S2 == "COPD-major", "CT-only-COPD",
  ifelse(dd$S4 == "COPD-major", "ESI-only-COPD", "Both-AFL-only"))),
  levels = c("Both-AFL-only", "ESI-only-COPD", "CT-only-COPD", "Both-COPD"))
d_al$discord <- mk_al(d_al); mort_al$discord <- mk_al(mort_al)
exa_al$discord <- mk_al(exa_al)
stopifnot(nrow(d_al) == sum(d_b$afl), !anyNA(d_al$discord))

rate_rows <- list(); prof_rows <- list()
for (g in levels(d_al$discord)) {
  i <- mort_al$discord == g; j <- exa_al$discord == g; z <- d_al[d_al$discord == g, ]
  rate_rows[[length(rate_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    group = g, n = nrow(z), n_mort = sum(i), deaths = sum(mort_al$vital_status[i]),
    resp_deaths = sum(mort_al$ev_resp[i]),
    rate_all_100py  = 100 * sum(mort_al$vital_status[i]) / sum(mort_al$py[i]),
    rate_resp_100py = 100 * sum(mort_al$ev_resp[i]) / sum(mort_al$py[i]),
    n_exac = sum(j),
    rate_exac_100py = 100 * sum(exa_al$Total_Exacerbations[j]) / sum(exa_al$Years_Followed[j]),
    prior_exac_mean = mean(exa_al$prior_exac[j]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  prof_rows[[length(prof_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    group = g, n = nrow(z),
    pct_visual_emph = 100 * mean(z$emph_yn), pct_wall_thick = 100 * mean(z$wall_yn),
    pct_meets_esi   = 100 * mean(z$ESI >= p4$t_low),
    mean_ESI = mean(z$ESI),
    mean_LAA950 = mean(z$Insp_LAA950_total_Thirona, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_PRM = mean(z$PRM_pct_emphysema_Thirona, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_dyspnea = 100 * mean(z$dysp_yn), pct_sgrq = 100 * mean(z$qol_yn),
    pct_cb = 100 * mean(z$cb_yn), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
disc_rates_al <- do.call(rbind, rate_rows)
disc_profile_al <- do.call(rbind, prof_rows)

m1 <- coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(py, vital_status) ~ discord +", COV)), data = mort_al)
m2 <- coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(py, ev_resp) ~ discord +", COV)), data = mort_al)
n1 <- glm.nb(as.formula(paste("Total_Exacerbations ~ discord +", COV,
       "+ prior_exac + offset(log(Years_Followed))")), data = exa_al)
cm <- summary(m1)$conf.int; cr <- summary(m2)$conf.int; ce <- summary(n1)$coef
adj_rows <- list()
for (g in levels(d_al$discord)[-1]) {
  r <- paste0("discord", g); k <- disc_rates_al$group == g
  gv <- function(M, j) if (r %in% rownames(M)) M[r, j] else NA_real_
  adj_rows[[length(adj_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    group = g, deaths_all = disc_rates_al$deaths[k],
    deaths_resp = disc_rates_al$resp_deaths[k],
    all_HR = gv(cm, 1), all_LCI = gv(cm, 3), all_UCI = gv(cm, 4),
    resp_HR = gv(cr, 1), resp_LCI = gv(cr, 3), resp_UCI = gv(cr, 4),
    exac_IRR = if (r %in% rownames(ce)) exp(ce[r, 1]) else NA_real_,
    exac_LCI = if (r %in% rownames(ce)) exp(ce[r, 1] - 1.96 * ce[r, 2]) else NA_real_,
    exac_UCI = if (r %in% rownames(ce)) exp(ce[r, 1] + 1.96 * ce[r, 2]) else NA_real_,
    all_few_events  = disc_rates_al$deaths[k] < MIN_EVENTS,
    resp_few_events = disc_rates_al$resp_deaths[k] < MIN_EVENTS,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
disc_adj_al <- do.call(rbind, adj_rows)
stopifnot(nrow(disc_rates_al) == 4, nrow(disc_adj_al) == 3,
          sum(disc_rates_al$n) == sum(d_b$afl))
write.csv(disc_rates_al,   file.path(OUT_DIR, "discord_rates_afl.csv"),   row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(disc_adj_al,     file.path(OUT_DIR, "discord_adjusted_afl.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(disc_profile_al, file.path(OUT_DIR, "discord_profile_afl.csv"),  row.names = FALSE)
print(disc_rates_al[, c("group","n","deaths","resp_deaths","rate_all_100py","rate_exac_100py")],
      digits = 3)
print(disc_profile[, c("group", "n", "pct_visual_emph", "pct_wall_thick",
                       "mean_ESI", "mean_LAA950", "mean_PRM")], digits = 3)
```

```{r discordance-rates}
# Observed rates per 100 person-years, and prior exacerbation burden, which
# the earlier analysis found explains much of the gradient in future
# exacerbations.
rate100 <- function(ev, py) 100 * sum(ev) / sum(py)
rows <- lapply(levels(d_ps$discord), function(g) {
  m <- mort_ps[mort_ps$discord == g, ]
  e <- exa_ps [exa_ps$discord  == g, ]
  data.frame(
    group          = g,
    n              = sum(d_ps$discord == g),
    n_mort         = nrow(m),
    deaths         = sum(m$vital_status),
    resp_deaths    = sum(m$ev_resp),
    rate_all_100py = rate100(m$vital_status, m$py),
    rate_resp_100py= rate100(m$ev_resp,      m$py),
    n_exac         = nrow(e),
    rate_exac_100py= rate100(e$Total_Exacerbations, e$Years_Followed),
    prior_exac_mean= mean(e$prior_exac, na.rm = TRUE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})
disc_rates <- do.call(rbind, rows)
# Rates must be ordered by increasing severity of the group definition for the
# narrative to hold; assert nothing, but surface it.
write.csv(disc_rates, file.path(OUT_DIR, "discord_rates.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
kable(disc_rates, digits = 2,
      caption = "Observed rates per 100 person-years by cross-classification group.")
```

```{r discordance-adjusted}
# Adjusted estimates against Both-noCOPD.
cm <- coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(py, vital_status) ~ discord +", COV)), data = mort_ps)
cr <- coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(py, ev_resp) ~ discord +",      COV)), data = mort_ps)
ne <- glm.nb(as.formula(paste("Total_Exacerbations ~ discord +", COV,
       "+ prior_exac + offset(log(Years_Followed))")), data = exa_ps)
sm <- summary(cm)$conf.int; sr <- summary(cr)$conf.int; se <- summary(ne)$coef

# A group with no events of a given type has no estimable hazard ratio. The
# Cox fit still returns a number: for CT-only-COPD, which has zero respiratory
# deaths, it returns 3e-07 with an interval of 0 to Inf. That is a monotone
# likelihood, not an effect size, and printing it as one would be worse than
# printing nothing. Such cells are set NA and the event count is carried
# alongside so the reason is visible in the artifact rather than inferred.
n_ev <- function(g, col) sum(mort_ps[[col]][mort_ps$discord == g])
adj <- do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(d_ps$discord)[-1], function(g) {
  r <- paste0("discord", g)
  gv <- function(M, j) if (r %in% rownames(M)) M[r, j] else NA_real_
  d_all  <- n_ev(g, "vital_status")
  d_resp <- n_ev(g, "ev_resp")
  est <- function(v, ok) if (ok) v else NA_real_
  data.frame(group = g,
    deaths_all = d_all, deaths_resp = d_resp,
    all_HR  = est(gv(sm,1), d_all  > 0), all_LCI = est(gv(sm,3), d_all  > 0),
    all_UCI = est(gv(sm,4), d_all  > 0),
    resp_HR = est(gv(sr,1), d_resp > 0), resp_LCI = est(gv(sr,3), d_resp > 0),
    resp_UCI= est(gv(sr,4), d_resp > 0),
    exac_IRR = if (r %in% rownames(se)) exp(se[r,1]) else NA_real_,
    exac_LCI = if (r %in% rownames(se)) exp(se[r,1]-1.96*se[r,2]) else NA_real_,
    exac_UCI = if (r %in% rownames(se)) exp(se[r,1]+1.96*se[r,2]) else NA_real_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
# Any surviving estimate must be finite and positive; a degenerate fit that
# slipped through the event-count guard would still be caught here.
.fin <- function(v) all(is.na(v) | (is.finite(v) & v > 0))
stopifnot(.fin(adj$all_HR), .fin(adj$resp_HR), .fin(adj$exac_IRR),
          .fin(adj$resp_UCI))
write.csv(adj, file.path(OUT_DIR, "discord_adjusted.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
kable(adj, digits = 2, caption = "Adjusted estimates against Both-noCOPD.")
```

# Section 9b -- Both strata together, for Figures 5 and 6

Profile, crude ratios and adjusted estimates for the concordant and discordant
groups in each stratum, laid out identically so the figures can set the strata
side by side. Crude intervals follow the rest of the paper: exact Poisson for
deaths, subject bootstrap for exacerbations, and no interval below the event
floor. Also the per-pathway agreement the Results quote, with a paired
bootstrap P for the difference between the two classifications.

```{r strata-combined}
set.seed(CV_SEED)
se_of <- function(v) { v <- v[!is.na(v)]; sd(v) / sqrt(length(v)) }
STRATA <- list(
  list(stratum = "Preserved spirometry", d = d_ps, m = mort_ps, e = exa_ps,
       ref = "Both-noCOPD"),
  list(stratum = "Airflow limitation", d = d_al, m = mort_al, e = exa_al,
       ref = "Both-AFL-only"))

prof_rows <- list(); crude_rows_s <- list()
for (st in STRATA) {
  lv <- levels(st$d$discord); ref <- st$ref
  stopifnot(ref %in% lv, ref %in% st$m$discord, ref %in% st$e$discord)
  for (g in lv) {
    z <- st$d[st$d$discord == g, ]
    prof_rows[[length(prof_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      stratum = st$stratum, group = g, n = nrow(z),
      mean_ESI = mean(z$ESI), se_ESI = se_of(z$ESI),
      mean_LAA950 = mean(z$Insp_LAA950_total_Thirona, na.rm = TRUE),
      se_LAA950 = se_of(z$Insp_LAA950_total_Thirona),
      pct_visual_emph = 100 * mean(z$emph_yn), pct_wall_thick = 100 * mean(z$wall_yn),
      pct_dyspnea = 100 * mean(z$dysp_yn), pct_sgrq = 100 * mean(z$qol_yn),
      pct_cb = 100 * mean(z$cb_yn), pct_meets_esi = 100 * mean(z$ESI >= p4$t_low),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  m <- st$m; e <- st$e
  ratio <- function(ev, py, dat, g)
    (sum(dat[[ev]][dat$discord == g]) / sum(dat[[py]][dat$discord == g])) /
    (sum(dat[[ev]][dat$discord == ref]) / sum(dat[[py]][dat$discord == ref]))
  others <- setdiff(lv, ref)
  boot_e <- replicate(CRUDE_B, {
    dd <- e[sample.int(nrow(e), nrow(e), replace = TRUE), ]
    vapply(others, function(g) ratio("Total_Exacerbations", "Years_Followed", dd, g),
           numeric(1)) })
  for (g in others) {
    for (o in c("all", "resp", "exac")) {
      if (o == "exac") {
        ev <- sum(e$Total_Exacerbations[e$discord == g])
        rr <- ratio("Total_Exacerbations", "Years_Followed", e, g)
        v <- boot_e[g, ]; v <- v[is.finite(v)]
        lo <- unname(quantile(v, .025)); hi <- unname(quantile(v, .975))
      } else {
        col <- if (o == "all") "vital_status" else "ev_resp"
        ev <- sum(m[[col]][m$discord == g])
        rr <- ratio(col, "py", m, g)
        ci <- exact_rate_ratio(ev, sum(m$py[m$discord == g]),
                               sum(m[[col]][m$discord == ref]), sum(m$py[m$discord == ref]))
        lo <- ci[1]; hi <- ci[2]
      }
      crude_rows_s[[length(crude_rows_s) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        stratum = st$stratum, group = g, outcome = o, events = ev,
        rr = rr, lo = lo, hi = hi, few_events = ev < MIN_EVENTS,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
  }
}
disc_profile_strata <- do.call(rbind, prof_rows)
disc_crude_strata   <- do.call(rbind, crude_rows_s)
stopifnot(nrow(disc_profile_strata) == 8, nrow(disc_crude_strata) == 18,
          sum(disc_profile_strata$n) == nrow(d_b))

cols <- c("group", "deaths_all", "deaths_resp", "all_HR", "all_LCI", "all_UCI",
          "resp_HR", "resp_LCI", "resp_UCI", "exac_IRR", "exac_LCI", "exac_UCI")
stopifnot(all(cols %in% names(adj)), all(cols %in% names(disc_adj_al)))
disc_adj_strata <- rbind(
  cbind(stratum = "Preserved spirometry", adj[, cols], stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  cbind(stratum = "Airflow limitation",  disc_adj_al[, cols], stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
stopifnot(nrow(disc_adj_strata) == 6)

# Per-pathway agreement, both directions, with a paired bootstrap for the
# difference in the share of each classification's assignments MD-COPD agrees
# with. Paired because both classifications label the same participants.
L3 <- d_b[, c("S2", "S3", "S4")]
share <- function(dd, s, g) { a <- dd[[s]] == g; if (!any(a)) NA_real_ else mean(dd$S2[a] == g) }
bs_ag <- replicate(CRUDE_B, {
  dd <- L3[sample.int(nrow(L3), nrow(L3), replace = TRUE), ]
  vapply(O, function(g) share(dd, "S4", g) - share(dd, "S3", g), numeric(1)) })
agree_rows <- lapply(O, function(g) {
  v <- bs_ag[g, ]; v <- v[is.finite(v)]
  data.frame(category = g, n_md = sum(L3$S2 == g),
             n_noct = sum(L3$S3 == g), agree_noct = sum(L3$S3 == g & L3$S2 == g),
             n_esi  = sum(L3$S4 == g), agree_esi  = sum(L3$S4 == g & L3$S2 == g),
             recall_noct = 100 * mean(L3$S3[L3$S2 == g] == g),
             recall_esi  = 100 * mean(L3$S4[L3$S2 == g] == g),
             p_boot = 2 * min(mean(v <= 0), mean(v >= 0)), B_eff = length(v),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE) })
agreement_by_group <- do.call(rbind, agree_rows)
agreement_by_group$pct_noct <- 100 * agreement_by_group$agree_noct / agreement_by_group$n_noct
agreement_by_group$pct_esi  <- 100 * agreement_by_group$agree_esi  / agreement_by_group$n_esi
stopifnot(sum(agreement_by_group$n_md) == nrow(d_b),
          sum(agreement_by_group$agree_esi)  == sum(d_b$S4 == d_b$S2),
          sum(agreement_by_group$agree_noct) == sum(d_b$S3 == d_b$S2))

write.csv(disc_profile_strata, file.path(OUT_DIR, "discord_profile_strata.csv"),  row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(disc_crude_strata,   file.path(OUT_DIR, "discord_crude_strata.csv"),    row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(disc_adj_strata,     file.path(OUT_DIR, "discord_adjusted_strata.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(agreement_by_group,  file.path(OUT_DIR, "agreement_by_group.csv"),      row.names = FALSE)
print(agreement_by_group[, c("category", "pct_noct", "pct_esi", "recall_noct", "recall_esi", "p_boot")],
      digits = 3)
```

```{r strata-profile-tests}
# Pairwise tests behind the Figure 5 brackets, within each stratum: Wilcoxon
# rank-sum for the two continuous measures, Fisher's exact test for the five
# criteria. Unadjusted. Where neither group has a criterion, or both have it
# throughout, there is nothing to test and P is 1.
PT_MEAS  <- c("ESI", "Insp_LAA950_total_Thirona", "emph_yn", "wall_yn",
              "dysp_yn", "qol_yn", "cb_yn")
PT_PAIRS <- list(c("CT-only-COPD", "ESI-only-COPD"), c("CT-only-COPD", "Both-COPD"),
                 c("ESI-only-COPD", "Both-COPD"))
pt_rows <- list()
for (st in STRATA) for (pr in PT_PAIRS) for (v in PT_MEAS) {
  a <- st$d[[v]][st$d$discord == pr[1]]; b <- st$d[[v]][st$d$discord == pr[2]]
  a <- a[!is.na(a)]; b <- b[!is.na(b)]
  cont <- v %in% PT_MEAS[1:2]
  p <- if (cont) wilcox.test(a, b, exact = FALSE)$p.value else {
    k <- sum(a) + sum(b)
    if (k == 0 || k == length(a) + length(b)) 1 else
      fisher.test(matrix(c(sum(a), length(a) - sum(a), sum(b), length(b) - sum(b)), 2))$p.value }
  pt_rows[[length(pt_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    stratum = st$stratum, measure = v, group1 = pr[1], group2 = pr[2],
    n1 = length(a), n2 = length(b), test = if (cont) "Wilcoxon" else "Fisher",
    p = p, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
disc_profile_tests <- do.call(rbind, pt_rows)
stopifnot(nrow(disc_profile_tests) == 42, all(is.finite(disc_profile_tests$p)),
          all(disc_profile_tests$n1 > 0), all(disc_profile_tests$n2 > 0))
write.csv(disc_profile_tests, file.path(OUT_DIR, "discord_profile_tests.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(disc_profile_tests[disc_profile_tests$group2 == "ESI-only-COPD", ], digits = 3)
```

# Section 10 -- Do the classifications differ? Paired bootstrap

The preceding sections report each classification's estimates side by side.
Reading a difference off two intervals is not a test of one, so this resamples
participants and refits BOTH classifications within every resample, taking the
difference of the log estimates for the same category. Pairing is what makes
the comparison valid: both estimates come from the same people in each draw,
so the between-classification correlation is preserved rather than assumed
away.

Each outcome is fitted in its own `tryCatch`. A warning from a sparse
respiratory fit must not discard the valid all-cause fits for that resample,
because dropped resamples are not missing at random: they are precisely the
ones with few respiratory events. Effective B is therefore tracked per outcome.

```{r paired-bootstrap}
B_DIFF <- 1000L
CACHE  <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "_cache"); dir.create(CACHE, showWarnings = FALSE)
CPATH  <- file.path(CACHE, "paired_bootstrap.rds")
CATS   <- c("AFL-only", "COPD-minor", "COPD-major")

# The fingerprint carries the model formulas, not just row counts, so any
# change to an outcome, covariate or offset invalidates the cache whether or
# not anyone remembers to bump a version.
.fml <- c(paste("Surv(py, vital_status) ~ S +", COV),
          paste("Surv(py, ev_resp) ~ S +",      COV),
          paste("Total_Exacerbations ~ S +", COV,
                "+ prior_exac + offset(log(Years_Followed))"))
# The formulas and row counts are identical whether or not the S4 rule
# changed, so a fingerprint built from those alone would silently reuse a
# bootstrap describing the previous classification. Carry the label vectors
# themselves.
.labels <- paste(paste(as.integer(d_b$S2), collapse = ""),
                 paste(as.integer(d_b$S4), collapse = ""), sep = "|")
.want <- list(n_mort = nrow(mort), n_exac = nrow(exa), B = B_DIFF,
              deaths = sum(mort$vital_status), resp = sum(mort$ev_resp),
              cats = paste(CATS, collapse = ","), fml = paste(.fml, collapse = "|"),
              labels = substr(digest::digest(.labels), 1, 12),
              version = 2L)
.cached <- if (file.exists(CPATH)) readRDS(CPATH) else NULL
if (!is.null(.cached) && !identical(.cached$fingerprint, .want)) {
  message("paired-bootstrap cache stale; recomputing")
  .cached <- NULL
}

if (!is.null(.cached)) {
  bootdiff <- .cached
  cat(sprintf("loaded cached paired bootstrap (B effective: all %d, resp %d, exac %d)\n",
              bootdiff$B_eff[["all"]], bootdiff$B_eff[["resp"]], bootdiff$B_eff[["exac"]]))
} else {
  set.seed(CV_SEED)
  mk <- function() matrix(NA_real_, nrow = B_DIFF, ncol = length(CATS),
                          dimnames = list(NULL, CATS))
  store <- list(all_S2 = mk(), all_S4 = mk(), resp_S2 = mk(), resp_S4 = mk(),
                exac_S2 = mk(), exac_S4 = mk())
  lg <- function(fit, term, nb = FALSE) {
    co <- if (nb) summary(fit)$coef else summary(fit)$coef
    if (!term %in% rownames(co)) return(NA_real_)
    unname(co[term, 1])
  }
  fit_cox <- function(dat, ev) tryCatch({
    lhs <- sprintf("Surv(py, %s)", ev)
    list(S2 = coxph(as.formula(paste(lhs, "~ S2 +", COV)), data = dat),
         S4 = coxph(as.formula(paste(lhs, "~ S4 +", COV)), data = dat))
  }, error = function(e) NULL, warning = function(w) NULL)
  fit_nb <- function(dat) tryCatch({
    rhs <- paste(COV, "+ prior_exac + offset(log(Years_Followed))")
    list(S2 = glm.nb(as.formula(paste("Total_Exacerbations ~ S2 +", rhs)), data = dat),
         S4 = glm.nb(as.formula(paste("Total_Exacerbations ~ S4 +", rhs)), data = dat))
  }, error = function(e) NULL, warning = function(w) NULL)

  B_eff <- c(all = 0L, resp = 0L, exac = 0L)
  for (b in seq_len(B_DIFF)) {
    im <- sample.int(nrow(mort), nrow(mort), replace = TRUE); dm <- mort[im, ]
    ie <- sample.int(nrow(exa),  nrow(exa),  replace = TRUE); de <- exa [ie, ]
    fa <- fit_cox(dm, "vital_status"); fr <- fit_cox(dm, "ev_resp"); fe <- fit_nb(de)
    if (!is.null(fa)) { for (g in CATS) {
        store$all_S2[b, g] <- lg(fa$S2, paste0("S2", g))
        store$all_S4[b, g] <- lg(fa$S4, paste0("S4", g)) }
      B_eff["all"] <- B_eff["all"] + 1L }
    if (!is.null(fr)) { for (g in CATS) {
        store$resp_S2[b, g] <- lg(fr$S2, paste0("S2", g))
        store$resp_S4[b, g] <- lg(fr$S4, paste0("S4", g)) }
      B_eff["resp"] <- B_eff["resp"] + 1L }
    if (!is.null(fe)) { for (g in CATS) {
        store$exac_S2[b, g] <- lg(fe$S2, paste0("S2", g), nb = TRUE)
        store$exac_S4[b, g] <- lg(fe$S4, paste0("S4", g), nb = TRUE) }
      B_eff["exac"] <- B_eff["exac"] + 1L }
  }
  bootdiff <- list(store = store, B_eff = B_eff, fingerprint = .want)
  saveRDS(bootdiff, CPATH)
  cat(sprintf("paired bootstrap done (B effective: all %d, resp %d, exac %d)\n",
              B_eff[["all"]], B_eff[["resp"]], B_eff[["exac"]]))
}

# Percentile interval on the difference in log estimates, and a two-sided
# bootstrap p from the proportion of draws on the other side of zero.
diff_row <- function(key, label, g) {
  d <- bootdiff$store[[paste0(key, "_S4")]][, g] -
       bootdiff$store[[paste0(key, "_S2")]][, g]
  d <- d[is.finite(d)]
  if (!length(d)) return(NULL)
  p <- 2 * min(mean(d <= 0), mean(d >= 0)); p <- min(1, p)
  data.frame(outcome = label, category = g,
             ratio_S4_over_S2 = exp(mean(d)),
             lo = exp(unname(quantile(d, .025))),
             hi = exp(unname(quantile(d, .975))),
             p_two_sided = p, B_eff = length(d), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
diffs <- do.call(rbind, unlist(recursive = FALSE, lapply(
  list(c("all","all-cause mortality"), c("resp","respiratory mortality"),
       c("exac","exacerbations")),
  function(o) lapply(CATS, function(g) diff_row(o[1], o[2], g)))))
write.csv(diffs, file.path(OUT_DIR, "schema_diff_bootstrap.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
kable(diffs, digits = 3,
      caption = "ESI-MD-COPD versus MD-COPD, same category, paired resamples. A ratio of 1 means the two classifications assign the same effect size.")
```

# Section 9 -- Self-check (canonical values echoed for drift detection)

Each row prints the freshly-computed value alongside the value cited in
the manuscript (`expected`). Rerunning this report on the cluster should
reproduce the `expected` column exactly (within rounding).

```{r self-check}
selfcheck <- function(name, computed, expected, tol = 0.02) {
  ok <- if (is.numeric(computed) && is.numeric(expected)) {
          isTRUE(abs(computed - expected) < tol)
        } else identical(computed, expected)
  data.frame(check = name,
             computed = if (is.numeric(computed)) sprintf("%.3f", computed)
                        else as.character(computed),
             expected = if (is.numeric(expected)) sprintf("%.3f", expected)
                        else as.character(expected),
             status = ifelse(ok, "PASS", "FAIL"),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

R2 <- function(s, cat, fld) risk[[fld]][risk$schema == s & risk$category == cat]
CR <- function(s, cat, out, fld) crude[[fld]][crude$schema == s & crude$category == cat & crude$outcome == out]
GT <- function(o, fld) {
  g <- do.call(rbind, gate_rows); g[[fld]][g$outcome == o]
}
DS <- function(s, fld) {
  d <- do.call(rbind, disc_rows); d[[fld]][d$schema == s]
}

# Canonical values are those cited in the manuscript prose. The point of
# this table is to detect drift on re-run: if any row goes FAIL, an
# expected number must be updated deliberately (with a corresponding
# manuscript edit) rather than silently changed. Every value is loaded
# from the already-written artifact so this block reflects what downstream
# reads, not what the in-memory objects happened to hold.

# MD-COPD counts BEFORE the baseline-ESI restriction are what should
# reproduce Bhatt Table 1 exactly. mdcopd_validation.csv captures that
# state; d_b at self-check time has already been ESI-restricted.
mdval <- read.csv(file.path(OUT_DIR, "mdcopd_validation.csv"),
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
MDV <- function(cat) mdval$ours[mdval$category == cat]

checks <- list(
  # ---- Bhatt Table 1 reproduction (before ESI restriction) --------------
  selfcheck("MD-COPD noCOPD n vs Bhatt 4,439",
            MDV("noCOPD"),          4439L),
  selfcheck("MD-COPD AFL-only n vs Bhatt 282",
            MDV("AFL-only"), 282L),
  selfcheck("MD-COPD COPD-minor n vs Bhatt 811",
            MDV("COPD-minor"),      811L),
  selfcheck("MD-COPD COPD-major n vs Bhatt 3,884",
            MDV("COPD-major"),      3884L),

  # ---- Analytic cohort after ESI restriction ---------------------------
  selfcheck("analytic cohort n (with baseline ESI)",
            as.integer(nrow(d_b)),  9240L, tol = 0.5),

  # ---- Nested LR gate: MD-COPD vs. fixed ratio (2 df) ------------------
  selfcheck("all-cause LR chi-square, MD-COPD over fixed ratio",
            GT("ALL-CAUSE MORTALITY", "lrt_chisq"),   122.1, tol = 0.1),
  selfcheck("respiratory LR chi-square, MD-COPD over fixed ratio",
            GT("RESPIRATORY MORTALITY", "lrt_chisq"),  76.1, tol = 0.1),
  selfcheck("exacerbation LR chi-square, MD-COPD over fixed ratio",
            GT("EXACERBATIONS", "lrt_chisq"),         158.9, tol = 0.1),

  # ---- Fitted CT-free rules --------------------------------------------
  selfcheck("NoCT-MD-COPD count threshold", k3,       2L),
  selfcheck("ESI-MD-COPD count threshold",  p4$k,     2L),
  selfcheck("ESI-MD-COPD T_low",            p4$t_low, 1.50, tol = 0.001),

  # ---- AFL-only risk, the load-bearing category ------------------
  selfcheck("MD-COPD AFL-only all-cause HR",
            R2("S2", "AFL-only", "all_HR"),  0.87, tol = 0.02),
  selfcheck("NoCT-MD-COPD AFL-only respiratory HR (should be highly elevated)",
            R2("S3", "AFL-only", "resp_HR"), 6.37, tol = 0.05),
  selfcheck("ESI-MD-COPD AFL-only all-cause HR (should straddle 1)",
            R2("S4", "AFL-only", "all_HR"),  0.96, tol = 0.02),

  # ---- Discrimination --------------------------------------------------
  selfcheck("MD-COPD all-cause C-index",
            DS("S2", "c_allcause"), 0.703, tol = 0.005)
)
selfcheck_tbl <- do.call(rbind, checks)
write.csv(selfcheck_tbl, file.path(OUT_DIR, "SELFCHECK.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
kable(selfcheck_tbl, caption = "Self-check -- computed vs canonical values.")
cat(sprintf("\nSelf-check summary: %d PASS, %d FAIL (of %d total)\n",
            sum(selfcheck_tbl$status == "PASS"),
            sum(selfcheck_tbl$status == "FAIL"),
            nrow(selfcheck_tbl)))
```

# Section 10 -- Completeness check

Enumerates every CSV downstream tables and figures depend on and aborts if
any is missing, so a partial run is caught here rather than surfacing as a
missing-file error deep in `draft_tables.R` or `build_manuscript.py`.

```{r completeness}
required_csvs <- c(
  "raw_discrimination.csv",
  "followup_medians.csv",
  "group_vs_mdcopd.csv",
  "cohort_flow.csv", "cohort.txt", "mdcopd_validation.csv",
  "schema_labels.csv", "schema_labels.rds", "schema_risk.csv",
  "schema_crude.csv", "schema_discrimination.csv", "schema_binary.csv", "binary_vs_mdcopd.csv",
  "schema_fit.csv", "schema_fit_cv_diff.csv", "schema_fit_cv_test.csv",
  "cv_schema_fits.csv",
  "objective_selection.csv", "reclassification.csv", "crossclass.csv",
  "supp_baseline.csv", "supp_esi_ct.csv", "metric_sweep.csv",
  "f1_by_category.csv", "esi_ct_levels.csv", "esi_ct_auc.csv",
  "discord_counts.csv", "discord_rates.csv", "discord_adjusted.csv",
  "schema_diff_bootstrap.csv", "fev1_decline.csv", "fev1_noct_vs_esi.csv",
  "continuous_esi_mortality.csv", "continuous_esi_gold0_decline.csv",
  "esi_trajectory.csv", "bronchodilator_delta_esi.csv",
  "gate_fixedratio.csv", "gate_exac_aic.csv", "SELFCHECK.csv",
  "consensus_ref_lost.csv", "cv_category_test.csv", "accuracy_test.csv",
  "discord_profile.csv", "discord_rates_afl.csv",
  "discord_adjusted_afl.csv", "discord_profile_afl.csv",
  "discord_profile_strata.csv", "discord_crude_strata.csv",
  "discord_adjusted_strata.csv", "agreement_by_group.csv", "discord_profile_tests.csv"
)
missing <- required_csvs[!file.exists(file.path(OUT_DIR, required_csvs))]
if (length(missing))
  stop("missing artifacts in OUT_DIR: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
cat(sprintf("All %d required artifacts present in %s\n",
            length(required_csvs), normalizePath(OUT_DIR)))
```
